title: Temple of Courage
objective: Deploy only after approval and upstream gates are complete.
intro: The gates to production stand ahead. Prove your nerve in four chambers before the release is allowed through.

trials.title: The Release Train
trials.prompt: Arrange the release so it reaches production safely.
trials.hint: Prove it somewhere safe first, ask for approval, then go live, and keep watching afterwards.
trials.success: The train runs on time with every gate checked.

trials.title: Ways to Cross the Bridge
trials.prompt: Match each deployment strategy to how it works.
trials.hint: Canary birds warn of danger early. Blue and green are two colours, so two environments.
trials.success: You know every road across the chasm.

pairs.right: Switch traffic between two identical environments
Release to a small share of users first
Replace instances a few at a time
Ship the code switched off, enable it later

trials.title: The Gate Room
trials.prompt: Configure the production environment. Light the protections that belong there.
trials.hint: Production needs approval, protected secrets and an escape route. It does not need auto-deploys from anywhere.
trials.success: Production is guarded and a way back is always open.
clues: Secrets live in the environment, never in the repository.
Only the main branch may deploy, and every deploy stays on record so you can roll back.

switches.label: Let any branch deploy to production

trials.title: The Moment of Truth
trials.prompt: Minutes after release, production errors spike. What is the bravest move?
trials.hint: Courage here means restoring service quickly, then investigating calmly.
trials.success: Restore first, investigate second. The kingdom stays standing.

options.text: Push an untested hotfix straight to production.
options.why: Rushing an untested fix can make things worse.

options.text: Wait and hope it settles down.
options.why: Users are hurting while you wait.

options.text: Roll back to the last good release, then investigate.
